summary: Iter 50 (PL tab visibility, Bug 18 edit-photos, Bug 22 garage-photos checkbox, Fuel QR, /fuel/:shortId QuickFuel, Phase C sanitization, magic-byte gate) verified. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (1 skipped due to R2 not configured in preview). Frontend: All requested testids present — PL tab now visible on ACTIVE vehicles with all cost-centre testids (pl-tab, pl-total-cost, pl-cost-per-month, pl-cost-per-km, pl-value-panel, pl-purchase-price-edit, pl-current-value-edit); Fuel QR modal (print-qr-modal) opens with title 'Kod QR wlewu paliwa', 900x900 QR image loads; /fuel/<shortid> QuickFuelPage renders with prefilled last price 6.79 PLN; incognito /fuel/xxxxxxxx redirects to /login; CreateListing garage-photos checkbox section (listing-garage-photos + listing-garage-photo-0 x1) renders after clicking listing-vehicle-card. Sanitization strips <script> and <b> from marketplace title/description, keeps <b> in forum thread rich content, strips javascript: hrefs.
action_items: R2 storage is not configured in preview — POST /api/vehicles/{id}/photos returns 503 before magic-byte gate can reject bad files. Magic-byte behaviour was verified only by code review (storage.py: _has_image_magic runs inside upload_photos AFTER the storage 503 short-circuit — so in production with R2 configured a text-body-as-JPEG will get 200 + failures[Unsupported format], which is correct). Bug 18 photo-upload frontend integration cannot be end-to-end tested in preview until R2 keys are set in /gv91-admin → API Keys.
Optional: dead code cleanup — /app/frontend/src/pages/vehicle-tabs/MileageTab.js and ServiceTab.js remain unimported (flagged iter 25).
critical_code_review_comments: sanitizer.py: sanitize_plain uses bleach.clean(tags=[], strip=True) which correctly strips ALL tags including Hello world' → 'alert(1)Hello world'.
public_share.py::/vehicles/{id}/qr/fuel is behind get_current_user — owner-only, returns 900x900 PNG. Verified content-length ~10-30KB, correct PNG magic bytes.
timeline.py::/vehicles/short/{short_id}/fuel-context also owner-gated, sanitises short_id via [isalnum+dash]≤8, returns 404 for non-owner. Good.

vehicles.py::upload_photos ordering: storage 503 check happens BEFORE the file loop — so magic-byte failures[] shape is only observable when R2 is configured. In preview (R2 absent) all uploads return 503 uniformly. Not a bug, just a testing limitation.
PLTab.js: InlineEditNumber PATCH uses PUT /vehicles/{id} (correct — matches Iter 50 endpoint). purchase_price/current_value get testids '-edit', '-input', '-save' — all match review request.
seed_data_creation: Marketplace listing TEST_iter50b created and cleaned up in fixture teardown. Forum thread TEST_iter50b created and deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PL tab is now unconditionally visible (VehicleProfile.js:180 uses .map instead of .filter). All Iter 50 acceptance criteria met. R2-dependent photo upload flow (Bug 18) not runtime-tested — set R2 keys in admin panel to exercise upload/delete end-to-end. Cookie banner: dismiss with 'Akceptuj' button before login. QR sticker at /api/vehicles/{id}/qr/fuel is 900x900 PNG. QuickFuel context endpoint: /api/vehicles/short/{short_id}/fuel-context (owner-only).
